Using the correct sum formula:
\[
S_9=\frac92(2a+8d)=45 \implies a+4d=5
\]
Together with \(a+d=2\), subtract:
\[
3d=3 \implies d=1,\quad a=1
\]
Thus \(a_n=n\), so
\[
b_n=\lfloor \lg n\rfloor.
\]

For \(n=1\) to \(1001\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
&n=1,\dots,9: \lfloor\lg n\rfloor=0 \quad (9\text{ terms})\\
&n=10,\dots,99: \lfloor\lg n\rfloor=1 \quad (90\text{ terms})\\
&n=100,\dots,999: \lfloor\lg n\rfloor=2 \quad (900\text{ terms})\\
&n=1000,1001: \lfloor\lg n\rfloor=3 \quad (2\text{ terms})
\end{aligned}
\]
Sum:
\[
0\cdot 9+1\cdot 90+2\cdot 900+3\cdot 2=90+1800+6=1896.
\]

\[
\boxed{1896}
\]
